record.question: Patriots _______ down their lives for their country.
record.explanation: Answer B: lay. The idiom is “lay down their lives” (= sacrifice them); lay is the correct form (B). Independent check: The phrase is “lay down one’s life” meaning sacrifice it; “Patriots” is plural, so the present-tense verb is “lay.” Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/lay-down; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/lay-down.
